narration.text: Why one brain implant carries up to 3,072 electrodes.
Each tiny wire holds 32 of them.
They record neurons firing as you intend to move.
In 2021, a monkey played Pong with one.
In 2024, the first human received the implant.
By 2025, patients with spinal injuries were getting them in Canada.
It decodes movement signals, not private thoughts.
So brain chips restore control long before they read minds.
